connectionSpecification.description: Writes streams as JSONL, CSV or Parquet files into a Google Cloud Storage bucket

bucket.description: Name of the bucket the files are written to
bucket.title: Bucket

bucket_path.description: Object name prefix every object is written under, without leading or trailing slash
bucket_path.title: Bucket Path

credentials.description: How the connector authenticates to Cloud Storage

service_account_info.description: The JSON key of a service account with roles/storage.objectAdmin on the bucket
service_account_info.title: Service Account Key JSON

oneOf.description: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, workload identity or the metadata server of the machine running the connector
oneOf.title: Application Default Credentials

credentials.title: Authentication

file_size_mb.description: A file is uploaded and a new one started once this many megabytes are written before compression
file_size_mb.title: File Size (MB)

oneOf.description: One object per record: _airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at and the record data verbatim under _airbyte_data

compression.description: none or gzip; gzip appends .gz to the object name
compression.title: Compression

oneOf.title: JSON Lines

oneOf.description: One column per declared top-level property; undeclared fields go to _airbyte_additional_properties

compression.description: none or gzip; gzip appends .gz to the object name
compression.title: Compression

oneOf.title: CSV

oneOf.description: One column per declared top-level property with logical types; undeclared fields go to _airbyte_additional_properties

decimal_scale.description: Digits after the decimal point of DECIMAL columns (0-38); a number with more digits fails the sync
decimal_scale.title: Decimal Scale

parquet_number_type.description: decimal writes JSON numbers as DECIMAL(38, decimal_scale); string writes their text
parquet_number_type.title: Number Type

oneOf.title: Parquet

max_records_per_file.description: A file is uploaded and a new one started once it holds this many records; 0 is no limit
max_records_per_file.title: Max Records per File

path_template.description: Object name below bucket_path. Tokens: {namespace}, {stream}, {yyyy}, {mm}, {dd}, {hh} (sync start, UTC), {field:<name>} (a top-level record field; null or missing is __null__, an empty string __empty__) and {part} (required in the last segment). {stream} is required in a directory segment, and only {namespace} and {stream} may come before the end of that segment. Empty segments are dropped; the format's extension is appended.
path_template.title: Path Template

connectionSpecification.title: GCS Destination Spec
